t: In front of you is A Sculpture for Mary Wollstonecraft, on Newington Green. It's by the British artist Maggi Hambling, and it was unveiled on the tenth of November 2020. It honours Wollstonecraft, the eighteenth-century writer and philosopher, who is regarded as one of the founding feminist philosophers and is best known for her advocacy of women's rights. Hambling is mainly a painter, and her best-known public works are this one and A Conversation with Oscar Wilde. Both have attracted controversy, so expect people to have opinions about it.
